name: Male Changeling
body:
While extremely rare, male changelings do exist. These beings often manifest spontaneously rather than from hag mothers (who usually kill any children who are born male). Spontaneous male changelings usually manifest from one of the following skelm heritages rather than from a hag heritage. Skelms are usually created when their parents are overwhelmed by feelings of anger and rage.

While female changelings are also theoretically possible with these skelm heritages, skelm-born changelings are almost universally male—just as hag-born ones are almost universally female. (Male changelings are traditionally called “lads” where female ones are ”mays.”)

Palace-Born Changeling (Corrupt Lad)

Palace-born are usually pretty ordinary looking—but they always do their best to look the part they need to play. Ambitious to a fault, they are masters of deception and skilled at playing the game of intrigue.

Ancestry palace skelm.

Typical Alignment Neutral.

Ability Modifiers +2 Str, +2 Cha, –2 Wis.

Skelm Species Trait You gain a +2 species bonus to Bluff checks, but take a –2 penalty to all saving throws against emotion effects.

Shrine-Born Changeling (Heretical Lad)

Shrine-born have pallid complexions, yellowed eyes, and sunken features. They are skilled at manipulation and can persuade others to follow them, but become angry with anyone who questions them.

Ancestry shrine skelm.

Typical Alignment Lawful Neutral.

Ability Modifiers +2 Int, +2 Cha, –2 Con.

Skelm Species Trait Traits You gain a +2 species bonus to Diplomacy checks, but take a –2 penalty to all saving throws against emotion effects.

Street-Born Changeling (Angry Lad)

Street-born have ruddy complexions and exaggerated facial features. They are easy to anger and wear their emotions on their sleeve, no matter what they are feeling.

Ancestry street skelm.

Typical Alignment Chaotic Neutral.

Ability Modifiers +2 Str, +2 Cha, –2 Wis.

Skelm Species Trait Traits You gain a +2 species bonus to Intimidate checks, but take a –2 penalty to all saving throws against emotion effects.

Awakened Hag Heritage

If you have the Awakened Hag Heritage feat, you gain the following benefits:

Moon-Born (Oblivion May) You can use lesser confusion once per day as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level and your highest mental ability score (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) as your caster ability score.
Void-Born (Star May) You gain immunity to cosmic rays and the environmental effects of vacuum, and you also gain the no breath universal monster ability. (You don’t breathe, and you are immune to effects that require breathing, such as inhaled poison; this does not give you immunity to cloud or gas attacks that don’t require breathing.)
Palace-Born (Corrupt Lad) You can use paranoia once per day as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your caster ability score.
Shrine-Born (Heretical Lad) You gain nondetection as a constant spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your caster ability score.
Street-Born (Angry Lad) You grow antlers that provide you with a gore attack. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d6 damage.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
